Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=97591 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 97591], [https://theswca.com/imgup/97591-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(64, 88, 665, 916)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>574dfd260f63bc54d8361fd4b7906940a7cd633ee4dc19272384da1e22f9bc25</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
